name: Brightside Health
one_liner: Measurement-based care platform specializing in depression and anxiety with 1,000+ medication combinations via PrecisionRx.
short_description: Brightside Health is a mental health platform specializing in evidence-based treatment for depression and anxiety using measurement-based care and PrecisionRx prescribing technology.
long_description: Brightside Health is a mental health platform founded in 2019 that specializes in treating depression and anxiety using a measurement-based care model. The platform tracks patient symptoms weekly using validated clinical measures (PHQ-9 for depression, GAD-7 for anxiety) and adjusts treatment accordingly. Brightside offers both therapy (video sessions with unlimited messaging) and psychiatry services, supported by its PrecisionRx decision tool that recommends from over 1,000 medication and dose combinations. Available in all 50 states plus DC, Brightside accepts major insurance including Aetna, Cigna, Anthem, UnitedHealthcare, and notably Medicare and Medicaid. Services extend to teens (ages 13+). Brightside also offers intensive outpatient programs (IOP) and a suicide prevention program.
best_for: Adults and teens with depression or anxiety seeking evidence-based care
Patients wanting measurement-based treatment with weekly symptom tracking
People seeking combined therapy and psychiatry on one platform
not_for: Patients needing controlled substances (benzodiazepines, ADHD stimulants)
Those seeking ADHD treatment (not a specialty focus)
Patients wanting longer psychotherapy sessions (45 min standard)

faqs.q: How much does Brightside Health cost?
faqs.a: Self-pay: Psychiatry is $95/month, therapy is $299/month (4 weekly sessions), or $349/month for both. With insurance (Aetna, Cigna, Anthem, UHC, Medicare, Medicaid), copays are typically $20-50.
No, Brightside cannot prescribe controlled substances including ADHD stimulants or benzodiazepines. The platform specializes in depression and anxiety treatment with non-controlled medications.

PrecisionRx is Brightside's clinical decision tool that helps psychiatrists select from over 1,000 medication and dose combinations for depression and anxiety, combined with weekly PHQ-9 and GAD-7 symptom tracking.

faqs.q: Does Brightside accept Medicare and Medicaid?
faqs.a: Yes, Brightside accepts Medicare and Medicaid in addition to major commercial insurance plans like Aetna, Cigna, Anthem, and UnitedHealthcare.
